fields.name: lookupTaxRate
fields.description:
Look up tax rates for a US address. Returns component rates (county, city,
state) and the combined total, all expressed as percentages (e.g. 8.25 for
8.25%). Requires PROPERTIES:READ permission.

For the most accurate result supply the full street address along with city
and stateCode — ZipTax can then resolve to the exact tax jurisdiction rather
than relying solely on the ZIP code.

args.description: US ZIP code (5-digit or ZIP+4). Optional when city/state or full address can identify the jurisdiction.

args.name: propertyId
args.description: Existing property ID. Enables Redis caching only when the property belongs to the current company and matches the lookup address.

args.name: city
args.description: City name — improves accuracy when multiple jurisdictions share the ZIP

args.name: county
args.description: County name — used as a secondary filter when multiple results match

args.name: address
args.description: Street address — enables ZipTax address-level lookup for maximum accuracy

args.name: stateCode
args.description: Two-letter US state code (e.g. TX)

fields.name: sendAiMessage
fields.description:
Send a message to the AI assistant and receive a response.

Available on Enterprise plans only.
Not available to MCP or OAuth API callers — direct browser/app sessions only.

Omit `chatId` to start a new conversation. Pass the `id` from a prior
`AiChat` response to continue an existing thread.

`responseFormat` defaults to MARKDOWN. Pass PLAIN_TEXT for SMS/email contexts.

`contextData` is an optional opaque JSON blob passed verbatim into the AI
system prompt. Use it to supply page context (e.g. currently-viewed record
IDs, date range, feature area) without schema churn.

at that weekly interval.
Requires calendar.UPDATE.

args.name: repeatEveryWeeks

types.name: __Type
types.description:
The fundamental unit of any GraphQL Schema is the type. There are many kinds of types in GraphQL as represented by the `__TypeKind` enum.

Depending on the kind of a type, certain fields describe information about that type. Scalar types provide no information beyond a name, description and optional `specifiedByURL`, while Enum types provide their values. Object and Interface types provide the fields they describe. Abstract types, Union and Interface, provide the Object types possible at runtime. List and NonNull types compose other types.

enumValues.name: ENUM

enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an input object. `inputFields` is a valid field.

types.name: __Directive

A Directive provides a way to describe alternate runtime execution and type validation behavior in a GraphQL document.

In some cases, you need to provide options to alter GraphQL's execution behavior in ways field arguments will not suffice, such as conditionally including or skipping a field. Directives provide this by describing additional information to the executor.
